description: This Java source file contains a test class 'ServicePermissionTests' that extends 'OFBizTestCase'. It includes multiple unit test methods to verify service permission, group permission, and error handling in the OFBiz framework. The tests utilize utility methods to prepare input maps, invoke services, and check results, especially focusing on security and permission-related functionality.

classes.name: ServicePermissionTests
classes.description: Test class for service permission checks, extending OFBizTestCase and containing multiple test methods.

methods.name: testPermissionSuccess

methods.name: testServicePermissionSuccess
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the service permission is successful based on input flags.

methods.name: testServicePermissionError
methods.description: Verifies that an error is raised when service permission check fails, expecting a ServiceAuthException.

methods.description: Checks that group and permission logic succeed for authorized user actions.
